name: Microsoft Configuration Manager
short_description: Microsoft's on-premises device management product. In co-management with Intune, workload sliders decide which system owns Windows Update policies.

evidence.quote: Now there's a wrinkle for estates that still use Configuration Manager.
SCCM was like market leader at that point of time
SCCM stands for System Center Configuration Manager.
SCCM is an on-premises tool that you run on your own servers inside your own building on your own network.
